chart.programText:
A = data('dynamo_frontend_output_tokens_total', rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('dynamo_frontend_requests_total', rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B).publish(label='C')

chart.description: Shows different requests & latency by models
chart.name: # Frontend overview
chart.programText:
A = data('dynamo_frontend_inflight_requests', rollup='latest').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='A')
B = data('dynamo_frontend_requests_total', rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model']).publish(label='B')
C = data('dynamo_frontend_queued_requests', rollup='latest').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='C')
D = histogram('dynamo_frontend_request_duration_seconds').percentile(pct=95, over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).mean(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model']).publish(label='D')
